cats.name: Mr. Miggles
cats.catName: Mr. Miggles (Mister Miggles), the grumpy tongue-out cat of Coinbase's July 2024 film
cats.whoIsTheCat: Mister Miggles is the fluffy, grumpy, tongue-out cat Coinbase made the star of its first fully onchain brand campaign: a 60-second film by Jack Begert, posted on X on 17 July 2024. He is played by a real cream-and-brown colorpoint longhair; the animal actor's name and owner were not published. Coinbase holds the IP and licensed it to purrLabs in Dec 2024.

virality.summary: In Coinbase's film a photo of Mr. Miggles goes viral and becomes thousands of memes, logos and merch, yet neither he nor his owner earns anything: 'Mr. Miggles drove the traffic, but Miggles missed the income.' It ends by asking creators to mint their work onchain. Coinbase's own Shorty Awards entry calls it the company's most viral social moment of 2024. The $MIGGLES contract was deployed on Base 26 minutes after Coinbase's '7.17.24' teaser; a day later Coinbase told fans to 'Remix Mister Miggles and earn onchain', and in October it posted a Halloween 'Miggles II' horror poster.
virality.metrics: Coinbase film post: 10,369,779 views, 10,776 likes, 1,704 reposts; '7.17.24' teaser: 2,023,092 views; remix call: 1,702,514 views; Halloween remix post: 758,613 views (fxtwitter, read 2026-09-25 21:50 UTC). Shorty Awards entry: 5.1M+ impressions, 600,000+ NFT mints (146,000+ unique), 70 ETH raised for the Base Creator Fund. @MrMigglesOnBase: 60,925 followers. Coin: 471,751 holders (GeckoTerminal 20:48 UTC; top 10 hold 26.6%).

coin.launched: 2024-07-16 16:33:59 UTC: contract deployed on Base (Blockscout creation tx 0xafe908...6d90), 26 minutes after Coinbase's '7.17.24' teaser post; the Uniswap v2 MIGGLES/WETH pool 0x17A3Ad...518a opened at 16:38:53 UTC (GeckoTerminal)

coin.endorsedByOwner: Partly. Coinbase created the character and holds the IP; the coin itself was started by fans, not by Coinbase. A purrLabs press release (Chainwire, 16-17 Dec 2024) says Coinbase licensed the Mr. Miggles IP to purrLabs, which runs the coin's Creator Fund, and miggles.io and the @MrMigglesOnBase bio ('IP rights from @coinbase') say the same. Coinbase's own Shorty Awards entry mentions the $Miggles meme coin its community created. No Coinbase statement endorsing the token itself was found.

cats.lore: Mr. Miggles is the fluffy, slightly grumpy cat with a pink tongue poking out who starred in Coinbase's one-minute film in July 2024. In the story, one snapshot of him goes viral and turns into thousands of memes, logos and T-shirts, yet neither Miggles nor his owner sees a cent. The film asked a simple question: shouldn't creators own their work? The internet answered by adopting him. Fans remixed him into movie posters and Halloween horror, and today Miggles is known as the creators' cat: still unimpressed, still blepping.

cats.name: Hosico
cats.catName: Hosico, the golden Scottish Straight of Moscow (@hosico_cat)
cats.whoIsTheCat: Hosico is a real male golden Scottish Straight ('black golden ticked'), born 4 August 2014 in Russia, who lives in Moscow with Roman and Ksenia. Their daughter, a fan of Japan, named him 'star child'. They began posting him on Instagram as a kitten; he had 662,000 followers by 2017 and about 1.7-1.9 million later, loved for his hamster cheeks and huge round eyes.

virality.summary: Hosico is one of Instagram's best-known cats, a round-faced golden fluff that fans compare to Puss in Boots, Garfield or a giant hamster. The Purrington Post counted 662,000 Instagram followers at his third birthday (2017), Munchiecat 1.9 million in 2022, and he was nominated for The Animal Star of 2020. The coin borrowed his name on letsbonk.fun in April 2025 and became one of that launchpad's biggest tokens by July 2025. In January 2026 the project moved to a new contract and retold him as 'Star Child', a glowing orange kitten with a star on his chest who gathers forgotten dreams.

Instagram @hosico_cat: ~1.7M (Cats of the Web, citing a Pictame snapshot of 1,732,004; Instagram needs a login and was not read directly). X @Hosico_cat: 16,354 followers. Coin: @Hosico_on_sol 10,305 followers; Telegram 3,275 members; 1,306 holders of the current contract, while 10,754 addresses still hold the old one (GeckoTerminal).

The coin uses its own illustrated art ('Star Child', an orange kitten) rather than the real cat's photos.

cats.lore: Hosico is a golden Scottish Straight from Moscow with round hamster cheeks and huge, dreamy eyes. His family brought him home as a shy little kitten after losing their old Siamese, Misha, and their daughter, who loved Japan, named him Hosico: star child. He hides when the doorbell rings, tires of new toys within a week, adores a drinking straw and a bit of black rope, and chatters at his people when playtime ends. Fans compare him to Puss in Boots and Garfield; the coin's artists imagine him as a glowing star child who gathers forgotten dreams.

cats.name: Red Kitten Crew
cats.catName: The red-headband kitten (an unnamed brown tabby), Roaring Kitty's X profile picture since 11 May 2026
cats.whoIsTheCat: An unnamed brown tabby kitten from a photo, mouth open mid-'roar', with a red headband added: the headband is Keith Gill's trademark from his Roaring Kitty GameStop livestreams. On 11 May 2026 this picture became the profile photo of Gill's X account @TheRoaringKitty (1.6M followers), and it still is. The kitten's owner and the photo's origin are unknown.

virality.summary: At about 21:13 UTC on 11 May 2026, after 16 months of silence, Keith Gill's verified @TheRoaringKitty account switched its picture to this kitten and posted RKC's pump.fun address with a short cat clip; a follow-up read 'red bandit crew 4 life'. The posts were deleted within roughly 30-60 minutes. RKC jumped to about $11-12M in market value within minutes and then crashed; Lookonchain said the developer's wallets exited with about $729k, and many traders suspected a hacked account. Gill has made no statement. The kitten is still his avatar, and holders now run RKC as a community takeover ('tie the band').
virality.metrics: @TheRoaringKitty: 1,615,999 followers (fxtwitter, read 2026-09-25 21:56 UTC); the avatar image was uploaded 2026-05-11 21:12:55 UTC (decoded from its X media ID). RKC's first 24h: ~$39.5M volume across ~195,000 transactions (Memeburn, citing GMGN); peak ~$11-12M market cap (Coinpedia, Cointelegraph). BitMart listed RKC on 12 May, 03:00 UTC. Today: 7,456 holders (GeckoTerminal; top 10 hold 25.1%); @RKCcoin: 472 followers (joined 2026-06-10).

coin.launched: 2026-05-11 21:07:33 UTC on pump.fun (bonding-curve pool 5L5Zzz...S2AJ); graduated to the PumpSwap RKC/SOL pool FzbYhP...5rCq at 21:13:06 UTC, the same minute as the Roaring Kitty post (GeckoTerminal)
coin.endorsedByOwner: No. Keith Gill has never confirmed or commented on the RKC posts, which were deleted within the hour; Cointelegraph, Coinpedia, CryptoPotato, Memeburn and Benzinga report a possibly compromised account and a developer exit of about $729k. RKC.GG's statement that the address 'was posted by Keith Gill' is the project's own reading. The kitten photo's owner is unknown.

cats.lore: Red Kitten Crew is a tiny brown tabby kitten, mouth wide open in its fiercest roar, with a red headband tied across its forehead. The headband is a nod to Keith Gill, the GameStop trader known as Roaring Kitty, whose red headband became a symbol of the 2021 retail rally. On 11 May 2026 this kitten appeared as his X profile picture, where it still sits today. The posts that came with it vanished within the hour and he has never explained them, but a crew of fans kept the kitten, tied on their own red headbands and made it their mascot.

cats.name: Cat Call Agent
cats.catName: Cat Call Agent ('Cat on Ink'), a lavender cartoon cat in a purple suit
cats.whoIsTheCat: A fictional 3D cartoon mascot: a lavender cat with violet forehead stripes, big teal eyes and a wide grin, in an ink-splattered purple suit and black tie. It is the face of Cat Call Agent, an AI agent 'with a feline persona' that reports on Ink, the Layer 2 chain released by Kraken; it calls itself the first cat on Ink, and its token dates from January 2025. Not a real pet.

virality.summary: Not a viral cat: Cat Call Agent is a small ecosystem mascot. Its X account @CatOnInkChain opened on 29 December 2024 and calls it the 'first cat on Ink'; its Telegram group calls $CAT 'the first agent on Ink ecosystem'. The agent's stated job is to watch for and report significant developments in the Ink ecosystem, and the team now also builds an 'Ink Bridge' route finder at catonink.com. Trading has almost stopped.
virality.metrics: @CatOnInkChain: 1,155 followers, 6,487 posts (joined 2024-12-29); Telegram @CatCallAgent: 323 members; 17,159 holder addresses (Ink Blockscout explorer); 24h trading volume $31 across 14 trades (CoinGecko and DexScreener, 2026-09-25 21:57 UTC).

cats.lore: Cat Call Agent is a cheerful lavender cat in a sharp purple suit and black tie, arms flung wide as if greeting everyone who arrives on Ink, the blockchain network released by the Kraken exchange. It calls itself the first cat on Ink, and its job is to keep an eye on the neighbourhood: an AI agent with a feline persona that watches for news across the Ink ecosystem and reports back to its community. Its suit is splashed with black ink blots, a little souvenir of home, and it never stops grinning.
